places-abrigo-del-mal-paso-penya-del-vic.story: 315 km from Millares to Millares, about 5 h 26 of riding. On the way it passes Barranc de la falaguera- Abric I, Cova de la Petxina, Barranc de la Penya Blanca and Penya del Vicari. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
